ar.title: كيف تقرأ تقرير الوظائف الشهري: شرح الرواتب، والبطالة، والمراجعات

segments.src: Every month, one number tends to dominate the financial headlines: the change in nonfarm payrolls.
segments.tr: في كل شهر، يميل رقم واحد إلى الهيمنة على العناوين المالية: التغير في الرواتب غير الزراعية.

segments.src: It is easy to treat it as a simple scorecard for the economy.
segments.tr: من السهل التعامل معه كبطاقة أداء بسيطة للاقتصاد.

segments.src: In practice, the headline is only the starting point.
segments.tr: من الناحية العملية، العنوان الرئيسي هو مجرد نقطة البداية.

segments.src: A careful reader looks at several pieces of the report together, because each answers a different question about the labor market.
segments.tr: ينظر القارئ المتأني إلى عدة أجزاء من التقرير معاً، لأن كل جزء يجيب على سؤال مختلف حول سوق العمل.

segments.src: This guide walks through what the monthly employment report measures, where its limits are, and how to put the pieces together.
segments.tr: يستعرض هذا الدليل ما يقيسه تقرير التوظيف الشهري، وما هي حدوده، وكيفية تجميع الأجزاء معاً.

segments.src: It is general education, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: هذا تعليم عام، وليس نصيحة استثمارية أو مالية.

segments.src: ## Where the Numbers Come From
segments.tr: ## من أين تأتي الأرقام

segments.src: The monthly report published by the U.S.
segments.tr: التقرير الشهري الذي ينشره مكتب

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) actually combines two separate surveys:
segments.tr: إحصاءات العمل الأمريكية (BLS) يجمع في الواقع بين مسحين منفصلين:

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** (sometimes called the payroll survey) asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. It produces the headline job gain or loss, as well as average hourly earnings and hours worked.
segments.tr: - **مسح المؤسسات** (يسمى أحياناً مسح الرواتب) يسأل أصحاب العمل عن عدد الأشخاص الموجودين في كشوف رواتبهم. وهو ينتج العنوان الرئيسي لمكاسب أو خسائر الوظائف، بالإضافة إلى متوسط الأجر في الساعة وساعات العمل.

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. It produces the unemployment rate, the labor force participation rate and the employment-to-population ratio.
segments.tr: - **مسح الأسر** يسأل عينة من الأسر عن حالة عملهم. وهو ينتج معدل البطالة، ومعدل المشاركة في القوى العاملة، ونسبة التوظيف إلى السكان.

segments.src: Because the two surveys use different methods and samples, they can send different signals in the same month.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن المسحين يستخدمان طرقاً وعينات مختلفة، فقد يرسلان إشارات مختلفة في نفس الشهر.

segments.src: That is not necessarily a mistake.
segments.tr: هذا ليس بالضرورة خطأ.

segments.src: It is a reminder that every figure is an estimate with a margin of error.
segments.tr: إنه تذكير بأن كل رقم هو تقدير مع هامش خطأ.

segments.src: ## 1. The Headline Payroll Number
segments.tr: ## 1. رقم الرواتب الرئيسي

segments.src: The payroll figure tells you how many jobs were added or lost across the economy, excluding farm work, private household work and a few other categories.
segments.tr: يخبرك رقم الرواتب بعدد الوظائف التي تمت إضافتها أو فقدانها عبر الاقتصاد، باستثناء العمل الزراعي، وعمل الأسر الخاصة، وبعض الفئات الأخرى.

segments.src: Some points of context help:
segments.tr: تساعد بعض نقاط السياق:

segments.src: - **Single months are noisy.** The estimate carries a sampling error of roughly plus or minus 100,000 jobs or so at the 90 percent confidence level. A gain of 150,000 and a gain of 200,000 may not be meaningfully different.
segments.tr: - **الأشهر الفردية صاخبة.** يحمل التقدير خطأ أخذ عينات يبلغ تقريباً زائد أو ناقص 100,000 وظيفة أو نحو ذلك عند مستوى ثقة 90 بالمائة. قد لا تكون الزيادة بمقدار 150,000 والزيادة بمقدار 200,000 مختلفة بشكل جوهري.

segments.src: - **The trend matters more than any one month.** Many analysts look at a three-month or six-month average to smooth out volatility.
segments.tr: - **الاتجاه يهم أكثر من أي شهر واحد.** ينظر العديد من المحللين إلى متوسط ثلاثة أشهر أو ستة أشهر لتخفيف التقلبات.

segments.src: - **The "right" number depends on the era.** The pace of job growth needed to keep the unemployment rate steady, sometimes called the breakeven rate, depends on labor force growth. When immigration, population aging or participation shifts, the breakeven pace shifts too. A figure that looked weak a few years ago may be adequate today, and vice versa.
segments.tr: - **الرقم "الصحيح" يعتمد على الحقبة.** تعتمد وتيرة نمو الوظائف اللازمة للحفاظ على استقرار معدل البطالة، والتي تسمى أحياناً معدل التعادل، على نمو القوى العاملة. عندما تتغير الهجرة، أو شيخوخة السكان، أو المشاركة، تتغير وتيرة التعادل أيضاً. الرقم الذي بدا ضعيفاً قبل بضع سنوات قد يكون كافياً اليوم، والعكس صحيح.

segments.src: - **Composition counts.** Broad-based gains across many industries are generally a healthier sign than growth concentrated in one or two sectors, such as health care and government.
segments.tr: - **التركيبة مهمة.** المكاسب واسعة النطاق عبر العديد من الصناعات هي عموماً علامة أكثر صحة من النمو المتركز في قطاع أو قطاعين، مثل الرعاية الصحية والحكومة.

segments.src: ## 2. Revisions to Earlier Months
segments.tr: ## 2. مراجعات الأشهر السابقة

segments.src: Revisions are among the most overlooked parts of the report, and they can be among the most important.
segments.tr: تعد المراجعات من بين أكثر أجزاء التقرير التي يتم تجاهلها، ويمكن أن تكون من بين أهمها.

segments.src: Each month, the BLS updates its estimates for the two prior months as more survey responses arrive.
segments.tr: في كل شهر، يقوم مكتب إحصاءات العمل (BLS) بتحديث تقديراته للشهرين السابقين مع وصول المزيد من ردود المسح.

segments.src: Once a year, it also performs a larger "benchmark" revision that aligns the survey-based estimates with more complete tax-based employment records.
segments.tr: مرة واحدة في السنة، يقوم أيضاً بإجراء مراجعة "معيارية" أكبر تتماشى مع التقديرات القائمة على المسح مع سجلات توظيف أكثر اكتمالاً قائمة على الضرائب.

segments.src: Why this matters:
segments.tr: لماذا هذا مهم:

segments.src: - **A strong headline can be offset by downward revisions**, leaving the underlying trend weaker than the first impression suggested. The reverse can also happen.
segments.tr: - **يمكن تعويض العنوان الرئيسي القوي بمراجعات هبوطية**، مما يترك الاتجاه الأساسي أضعف مما اقترحه الانطباع الأول. يمكن أن يحدث العكس أيضاً.

segments.src: - **Revisions often show turning points late.** When the economy is changing direction, early estimates can miss the shift, and later revisions fill in the picture.
segments.tr: - **غالباً ما تظهر المراجعات نقاط التحول متأخرة.** عندما يغير الاقتصاد اتجاهه، يمكن للتقديرات المبكرة أن تفوت التحول، وتملأ المراجعات اللاحقة الصورة.

segments.src: - **The first print is a first draft.** Treat it as a preliminary reading rather than a final verdict.
segments.tr: - **النسخة الأولى هي مسودة أولى.** تعامل معها كقراءة أولية بدلاً من حكم نهائي.

segments.src: A practical habit: when you read about a new report, check the net revision to the prior two months before deciding whether the data looks stronger or weaker than before.
segments.tr: عادة عملية: عندما تقرأ عن تقرير جديد، تحقق من صافي المراجعة للشهرين السابقين قبل أن تقرر ما إذا كانت البيانات تبدو أقوى أو أضعف من ذي قبل.

segments.src: ## 3. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ## 3. معدل البطالة

segments.src: The unemployment rate is the share of people in the labor force who are without a job and actively looking for work.
segments.tr: معدل البطالة هو حصة الأشخاص في القوى العاملة الذين ليس لديهم وظيفة ويبحثون بنشاط عن عمل.

segments.src: It is a useful summary, but it has quirks.
segments.tr: إنه ملخص مفيد، لكن له غرائب.

segments.src: - **Small moves can be noise.** A change of one or two tenths of a percentage point is often within the statistical margin and may reverse the following month.
segments.tr: - **التحركات الصغيرة يمكن أن تكون ضجيجاً.** غالباً ما يكون التغيير بمقدار عُشر أو عُشرين من النقطة المئوية ضمن الهامش الإحصائي وقد ينعكس في الشهر التالي.

segments.src: - **Why the rate moved matters.** The rate can rise because people lose jobs, which is a negative sign. It can also rise because more people enter or re-enter the labor force and have not yet found work, which can be a more neutral or even positive sign.
segments.tr: - **سبب تحرك المعدل مهم.** يمكن أن يرتفع المعدل لأن الناس يفقدون وظائفهم، وهي علامة سلبية. يمكن أن يرتفع أيضاً لأن المزيد من الناس يدخلون أو يعيدون دخول القوى العاملة ولم يجدوا عملاً بعد، وهو ما يمكن أن يكون علامة أكثر حيادية أو حتى إيجابية.

segments.src: - **It can fall for unhappy reasons.** If discouraged workers stop looking, they drop out of the labor force and the rate can decline without any improvement in hiring.
segments.tr: - **يمكن أن ينخفض لأسباب غير سعيدة.** إذا توقف العمال المحبطون عن البحث، فإنهم يخرجون من القوى العاملة ويمكن أن ينخفض المعدل دون أي تحسن في التوظيف.

segments.src: To understand which story is playing out, look beside the headline rate at the **labor force participation rate** and the **employment-to-population ratio** for prime-age workers (ages 25 to 54).
segments.tr: لفهم القصة التي تتكشف، انظر بجانب المعدل الرئيسي إلى **معدل المشاركة في القوى العاملة** و**نسبة التوظيف إلى السكان** للعمال في سن العمل (من 25 إلى 54 عاماً).

segments.src: These measures are less affected by population aging and give a clearer view of how many people in their peak working years are actually employed.
segments.tr: هذه المقاييس أقل تأثراً بشيخوخة السكان وتعطي رؤية أوضح لعدد الأشخاص في سنوات عملهم الذروة الذين يعملون بالفعل.

segments.src: The BLS also publishes broader measures, including the **U-6 rate**, which adds people working part-time who want full-time work and those marginally attached to the labor force.
segments.tr: ينشر مكتب إحصاءات العمل (BLS) أيضاً مقاييس أوسع، بما في ذلك **معدل U-6**، الذي يضيف الأشخاص الذين يعملون بدوام جزئي ويرغبون في عمل بدوام كامل وأولئك المرتبطين بشكل هامشي بالقوى العاملة.

segments.src: A widening gap between U-6 and the headline rate can hint at slack that the headline hides.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تشير الفجوة المتزايدة بين U-6 والمعدل الرئيسي إلى الركود الذي يخفيه العنوان الرئيسي.

segments.src: ## 4. Wage Growth
segments.tr: ## 4. نمو الأجور

segments.src: Average hourly earnings show how fast pay is rising, and they connect the jobs report to inflation and household budgets.
segments.tr: يوضح متوسط الأجر في الساعة مدى سرعة ارتفاع الأجور، وهي تربط تقرير الوظائف بالتضخم وميزانيات الأسرة.

segments.src: - **Look at the year-over-year change** for the broad trend and the monthly change for the latest momentum, while remembering that the monthly figure is volatile.
segments.tr: - **انظر إلى التغير على أساس سنوي** للاتجاه العام والتغير الشهري لأحدث زخم، مع تذكر أن الرقم الشهري متقلب.

segments.src: - **Compare wage growth with inflation.** If pay rises faster than prices, workers' purchasing power improves. If it lags, real incomes shrink.
segments.tr: - **قارن نمو الأجور بالتضخم.** إذا ارتفعت الأجور بشكل أسرع من الأسعار، تتحسن القوة الشرائية للعمال. إذا تخلفت، تنكمش الدخول الحقيقية.

segments.src: - **Mind the composition effect.** If lower-paid workers are laid off, average wages can rise even though no one received a raise. The reverse can occur when many lower-paid workers are hired.
segments.tr: - **انتبه لتأثير التركيبة.** إذا تم تسريح العمال ذوي الأجور المنخفضة، يمكن أن يرتفع متوسط الأجور على الرغم من أن أحداً لم يحصل على زيادة. يمكن أن يحدث العكس عندما يتم توظيف العديد من العمال ذوي الأجور المنخفضة.

segments.src: - **Consider other sources.** The BLS Employment Cost Index and the Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker follow compensation in ways that are less sensitive to changes in who is employed.
segments.tr: - **فكر في مصادر أخرى.** يتابع مؤشر تكلفة التوظيف التابع لمكتب إحصاءات العمل (BLS) ومتتبع نمو الأجور التابع للاحتياطي الفيدرالي في أتلانتا التعويضات بطرق أقل حساسية للتغيرات في من يعمل.

segments.src: Wages that grow much faster than productivity can add to inflation pressure.
segments.tr: الأجور التي تنمو بشكل أسرع بكثير من الإنتاجية يمكن أن تزيد من ضغط التضخم.

segments.src: Wages that stall can signal a cooling labor market.
segments.tr: الأجور التي تتوقف يمكن أن تشير إلى تباطؤ سوق العمل.

segments.src: Policymakers watch for both.
segments.tr: يراقب صناع السياسات كلاهما.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Details Worth a Glance
segments.tr: ## 5. تفاصيل أخرى تستحق نظرة

segments.src: - **Average weekly hours.** Employers often trim hours before they cut jobs, so a drop in hours can be an early warning.
segments.tr: - **متوسط ساعات العمل الأسبوعية.** غالباً ما يقلص أصحاب العمل الساعات قبل أن يقطعوا الوظائف، لذا يمكن أن يكون انخفاض الساعات تحذيراً مبكراً.

segments.src: - **Diffusion index.** This shows the share of industries adding jobs. A higher share suggests broader strength.
segments.tr: - **مؤشر الانتشار.** يوضح هذا حصة الصناعات التي تضيف وظائف. تشير الحصة الأعلى إلى قوة أوسع.

segments.src: - **Job openings, quits and layoffs.** The separate JOLTS report and weekly jobless claims offer timely cross-checks on hiring and firing.
segments.tr: - **فرص العمل، والاستقالات، والتسريحات.** يقدم تقرير JOLTS المنفصل ومطالبات البطالة الأسبوعية عمليات تحقق متقاطعة في الوقت المناسب بشأن التوظيف والفصل.

segments.src: - **Temporary help and goods-producing employment.** These sectors are sometimes seen as early indicators of changes in business activity.
segments.tr: - **العمالة المؤقتة والعمالة المنتجة للسلع.** يُنظر إلى هذه القطاعات أحياناً كمؤشرات مبكرة للتغيرات في نشاط الأعمال.

segments.src: ## Why the Federal Reserve Cares
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهتم الاحتياطي الفيدرالي

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: لدى الاحتياطي الفيدرالي تفويض مزدوج: أقصى قدر من التوظيف واستقرار الأسعار.

segments.src: The jobs report speaks to both.
segments.tr: يتحدث تقرير الوظائف عن كليهما.

segments.src: Strong hiring and fast wage growth may argue for patience on interest rate cuts, or for firmer policy, if inflation is a concern.
segments.tr: قد يجادل التوظيف القوي ونمو الأجور السريع من أجل الصبر على تخفيضات أسعار الفائدة، أو من أجل سياسة أكثر صرامة، إذا كان التضخم مصدر قلق.

segments.src: A rising unemployment rate, downward revisions and slowing wage growth may strengthen the case for easing.
segments.tr: قد يعزز ارتفاع معدل البطالة، والمراجعات الهبوطية، وتباطؤ نمو الأجور الحجة للتيسير.

segments.src: Markets often react sharply to the headline, but policymakers say they look at a wide range of data over time.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تتفاعل الأسواق بحدة مع العنوان الرئيسي، لكن صناع السياسات يقولون إنهم ينظرون إلى مجموعة واسعة من البيانات بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: No single report decides the path of interest rates, and the Fed's judgment also draws on inflation readings, financial conditions and its own forecasts.
segments.tr: لا يوجد تقرير واحد يقرر مسار أسعار الفائدة، ويعتمد حكم الاحتياطي الفيدرالي أيضاً على قراءات التضخم، والظروف المالية، وتوقعاته الخاصة.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist for Reading the Report
segments.tr: ## قائمة مرجعية بسيطة لقراءة التقرير

segments.src: 1. **Headline payrolls:** How does the figure compare with the recent three-month average and with the breakeven pace?
segments.tr: 1. **الرواتب الرئيسية:** كيف يقارن الرقم بمتوسط الثلاثة أشهر الأخيرة وبوتيرة التعادل؟

segments.src: 2. **Revisions:** Were the prior two months revised up or down, and by how much?
segments.tr: 2. **المراجعات:** هل تمت مراجعة الشهرين السابقين بالزيادة أو النقصان، وبأي مقدار؟

segments.src: 3. **Unemployment rate:** Did it move because of layoffs, or because people entered or left the labor force?
segments.tr: 3. **معدل البطالة:** هل تحرك بسبب التسريحات، أم لأن الناس دخلوا أو غادروا القوى العاملة؟

segments.src: 4. **Participation and prime-age employment:** Are more people in their working years employed?
segments.tr: 4. **المشاركة وتوظيف سن العمل:** هل يعمل المزيد من الأشخاص في سنوات عملهم؟

segments.src: 5. **Wages:** Is pay growth outpacing inflation, and could composition be distorting it?
segments.tr: 5. **الأجور:** هل نمو الأجور يتجاوز التضخم، وهل يمكن أن تشوهه التركيبة؟

segments.src: 6. **Breadth:** Are gains spread across industries or concentrated in a few?
segments.tr: 6. **الاتساع:** هل المكاسب منتشرة عبر الصناعات أم تتركز في القليل منها؟

segments.src: 7. **Hours and other signals:** Do they support or contradict the headline?
segments.tr: 7. **الساعات والإشارات الأخرى:** هل تدعم العنوان الرئيسي أم تناقضه؟

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The monthly jobs report is rich, imperfect and frequently revised.
segments.tr: تقرير الوظائف الشهري غني، وغير كامل، ويتم مراجعته بشكل متكرر.

segments.src: Treat the first headline as a snapshot, not a verdict.
segments.tr: تعامل مع العنوان الرئيسي الأول كلقطة، وليس كحكم.

segments.src: The most reliable insight comes from combining payroll trends, revisions, the unemployment rate and wage growth, then watching whether the pattern holds over several months.
segments.tr: تأتي الرؤية الأكثر موثوقية من الجمع بين اتجاهات الرواتب، والمراجعات، ومعدل البطالة، ونمو الأجور، ثم مراقبة ما إذا كان النمط يستمر على مدى عدة أشهر.

segments.src: Looked at this way, the report becomes less a source of dramatic surprises and more a steady guide to how the labor market is evolving.

fr.title: Comment lire le rapport mensuel sur l'emploi : effectifs salariés, chômage et révisions expliqués

segments.src: Every month, one number tends to dominate the financial headlines: the change in nonfarm payrolls.
segments.tr: Chaque mois, un chiffre tend à dominer les gros titres financiers : la variation des effectifs salariés non agricoles.

segments.src: It is easy to treat it as a simple scorecard for the economy.
segments.tr: Il est tentant d'y voir une simple fiche de notes de l'économie.

segments.src: In practice, the headline is only the starting point.
segments.tr: En pratique, le chiffre phare n'est que le point de départ.

segments.src: A careful reader looks at several pieces of the report together, because each answers a different question about the labor market.
segments.tr: Un lecteur attentif examine ensemble plusieurs éléments du rapport, car chacun répond à une question différente sur le marché du travail.

segments.src: This guide walks through what the monthly employment report measures, where its limits are, and how to put the pieces together.
segments.tr: Ce guide présente ce que mesure le rapport mensuel sur l'emploi, ses limites, et comment assembler les différents éléments.

segments.src: It is general education, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'une information générale à caractère pédagogique, et non d'un conseil en investissement ou financier.

segments.src: ## Where the Numbers Come From
segments.tr: ## D'où viennent les chiffres

segments.src: The monthly report published by the U.S.
segments.tr: Le rapport mensuel publié par le

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) actually combines two separate surveys:
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) américain combine en fait deux enquêtes distinctes :

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** (sometimes called the payroll survey) asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. It produces the headline job gain or loss, as well as average hourly earnings and hours worked.
segments.tr: - **L'enquête auprès des établissements** (parfois appelée enquête sur les effectifs salariés) demande aux employeurs combien de personnes figurent sur leurs effectifs. Elle produit la variation phare des emplois, ainsi que les gains horaires moyens et les heures travaillées.

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. It produces the unemployment rate, the labor force participation rate and the employment-to-population ratio.
segments.tr: - **L'enquête auprès des ménages** interroge un échantillon de ménages sur leur situation d'emploi. Elle produit le taux de chômage, le taux d'activité et le taux d'emploi (rapport entre l'emploi et la population).

segments.src: Because the two surveys use different methods and samples, they can send different signals in the same month.
segments.tr: Comme les deux enquêtes utilisent des méthodes et des échantillons différents, elles peuvent envoyer des signaux divergents le même mois.

segments.src: That is not necessarily a mistake.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas forcément une erreur.

segments.src: It is a reminder that every figure is an estimate with a margin of error.
segments.tr: C'est un rappel que chaque chiffre est une estimation assortie d'une marge d'erreur.

segments.src: ## 1. The Headline Payroll Number
segments.tr: ## 1. Le chiffre phare des effectifs salariés

segments.src: The payroll figure tells you how many jobs were added or lost across the economy, excluding farm work, private household work and a few other categories.
segments.tr: Le chiffre des effectifs indique combien d'emplois ont été créés ou supprimés dans l'ensemble de l'économie, hors travail agricole, emploi domestique privé et quelques autres catégories.

segments.src: Some points of context help:
segments.tr: Quelques éléments de contexte sont utiles :

segments.src: - **Single months are noisy.** The estimate carries a sampling error of roughly plus or minus 100,000 jobs or so at the 90 percent confidence level. A gain of 150,000 and a gain of 200,000 may not be meaningfully different.
segments.tr: - **Les mois isolés sont bruités.** L'estimation comporte une erreur d'échantillonnage d'environ plus ou moins 100 000 emplois, au niveau de confiance de 90 %. Un gain de 150 000 et un gain de 200 000 peuvent ne pas être significativement différents.

segments.src: - **The trend matters more than any one month.** Many analysts look at a three-month or six-month average to smooth out volatility.
segments.tr: - **La tendance compte plus que le chiffre d'un mois.** De nombreux analystes regardent une moyenne sur trois ou six mois pour lisser la volatilité.

segments.src: - **The "right" number depends on the era.** The pace of job growth needed to keep the unemployment rate steady, sometimes called the breakeven rate, depends on labor force growth. When immigration, population aging or participation shifts, the breakeven pace shifts too. A figure that looked weak a few years ago may be adequate today, and vice versa.
segments.tr: - **Le « bon » chiffre dépend de l'époque.** Le rythme de création d'emplois nécessaire pour maintenir stable le taux de chômage, parfois appelé rythme d'équilibre, dépend de la croissance de la population active. Quand l'immigration, le vieillissement de la population ou l'évolution de la participation changent, le rythme d'équilibre change aussi. Un chiffre qui semblait faible il y a quelques années peut être suffisant aujourd'hui, et inversement.

segments.src: - **Composition counts.** Broad-based gains across many industries are generally a healthier sign than growth concentrated in one or two sectors, such as health care and government.
segments.tr: - **La composition compte.** Des gains largement répartis entre de nombreux secteurs sont généralement un signe plus sain qu'une croissance concentrée dans un ou deux secteurs, comme la santé et l'administration publique.

segments.src: ## 2. Revisions to Earlier Months
segments.tr: ## 2. Les révisions des mois précédents

segments.src: Revisions are among the most overlooked parts of the report, and they can be among the most important.
segments.tr: Les révisions font partie des éléments les plus négligés du rapport, et peuvent être parmi les plus importants.

segments.src: Each month, the BLS updates its estimates for the two prior months as more survey responses arrive.
segments.tr: Chaque mois, le BLS actualise ses estimations pour les deux mois précédents à mesure que de nouvelles réponses d'enquête arrivent.

segments.src: Once a year, it also performs a larger "benchmark" revision that aligns the survey-based estimates with more complete tax-based employment records.
segments.tr: Une fois par an, il effectue aussi une révision annuelle plus large de « référence », qui aligne les estimations issues des enquêtes sur des registres fiscaux d'emploi plus complets.

segments.src: Why this matters:
segments.tr: Pourquoi c'est important :

segments.src: - **A strong headline can be offset by downward revisions**, leaving the underlying trend weaker than the first impression suggested. The reverse can also happen.
segments.tr: - **Un chiffre phare solide peut être compensé par des révisions à la baisse**, laissant la tendance sous-jacente plus faible que la première impression ne le laissait croire. L'inverse peut aussi se produire.

segments.src: - **Revisions often show turning points late.** When the economy is changing direction, early estimates can miss the shift, and later revisions fill in the picture.
segments.tr: - **Les révisions signalent souvent les points de retournement tardivement.** Lorsque l'économie change de direction, les premières estimations peuvent manquer le changement, et les révisions ultérieures complètent le tableau.

segments.src: - **The first print is a first draft.** Treat it as a preliminary reading rather than a final verdict.
segments.tr: - **La première publication est un premier jet.** Considérez-la comme une lecture préliminaire plutôt que comme un verdict définitif.

segments.src: A practical habit: when you read about a new report, check the net revision to the prior two months before deciding whether the data looks stronger or weaker than before.
segments.tr: Une habitude pratique : lorsque vous lisez un nouveau rapport, vérifiez la révision nette apportée aux deux mois précédents avant de décider si les données semblent plus solides ou plus faibles qu'auparavant.

segments.src: ## 3. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ## 3. Le taux de chômage

segments.src: The unemployment rate is the share of people in the labor force who are without a job and actively looking for work.
segments.tr: Le taux de chômage est la part des personnes actives qui sont sans emploi et recherchent activement un travail.

segments.src: It is a useful summary, but it has quirks.
segments.tr: C'est un indicateur utile, mais il a ses particularités.

segments.src: - **Small moves can be noise.** A change of one or two tenths of a percentage point is often within the statistical margin and may reverse the following month.
segments.tr: - **Les petits mouvements peuvent être du bruit.** Une variation d'un ou deux dixièmes de point de pourcentage se situe souvent dans la marge statistique et peut s'inverser le mois suivant.

segments.src: - **Why the rate moved matters.** The rate can rise because people lose jobs, which is a negative sign. It can also rise because more people enter or re-enter the labor force and have not yet found work, which can be a more neutral or even positive sign.
segments.tr: - **Le pourquoi de la variation compte.** Le taux peut augmenter parce que des personnes perdent leur emploi, ce qui est un signe négatif. Il peut aussi augmenter parce que davantage de personnes entrent ou reviennent sur le marché du travail sans encore avoir trouvé de poste, ce qui peut être un signe plus neutre, voire positif.

segments.src: - **It can fall for unhappy reasons.** If discouraged workers stop looking, they drop out of the labor force and the rate can decline without any improvement in hiring.
segments.tr: - **Il peut baisser pour de mauvaises raisons.** Si des travailleurs découragés cessent de chercher, ils sortent de la population active et le taux peut diminuer sans aucune amélioration des embauches.

segments.src: To understand which story is playing out, look beside the headline rate at the **labor force participation rate** and the **employment-to-population ratio** for prime-age workers (ages 25 to 54).
segments.tr: Pour comprendre quel scénario se joue, regardez à côté du taux phare le **taux d'activité** et le **taux d'emploi des actifs en âge de pleine activité** (25 à 54 ans).

segments.src: These measures are less affected by population aging and give a clearer view of how many people in their peak working years are actually employed.
segments.tr: Ces indicateurs sont moins affectés par le vieillissement de la population et donnent une vision plus claire du nombre de personnes en âge de pleine activité qui sont effectivement employées.

segments.src: The BLS also publishes broader measures, including the **U-6 rate**, which adds people working part-time who want full-time work and those marginally attached to the labor force.
segments.tr: Le BLS publie aussi des mesures plus larges, notamment le **taux U-6**, qui ajoute les personnes travaillant à temps partiel qui souhaitent un temps plein et les personnes faiblement rattachées au marché du travail.

segments.src: A widening gap between U-6 and the headline rate can hint at slack that the headline hides.
segments.tr: Un écart qui se creuse entre U-6 et le taux phare peut signaler une sous-utilisation de la main-d'œuvre que le taux principal masque.

segments.src: ## 4. Wage Growth
segments.tr: ## 4. La croissance des salaires

segments.src: Average hourly earnings show how fast pay is rising, and they connect the jobs report to inflation and household budgets.
segments.tr: Les gains horaires moyens montrent la vitesse de progression des salaires, et relient le rapport sur l'emploi à l'inflation et aux budgets des ménages.

segments.src: - **Look at the year-over-year change** for the broad trend and the monthly change for the latest momentum, while remembering that the monthly figure is volatile.
segments.tr: - **Regardez la variation sur un an** pour la tendance générale et la variation mensuelle pour la dynamique la plus récente, en gardant à l'esprit que le chiffre mensuel est volatil.

segments.src: - **Compare wage growth with inflation.** If pay rises faster than prices, workers' purchasing power improves. If it lags, real incomes shrink.
segments.tr: - **Comparez la croissance des salaires à l'inflation.** Si les salaires augmentent plus vite que les prix, le pouvoir d'achat des travailleurs s'améliore. S'ils prennent du retard, les revenus réels diminuent.

segments.src: - **Mind the composition effect.** If lower-paid workers are laid off, average wages can rise even though no one received a raise. The reverse can occur when many lower-paid workers are hired.
segments.tr: - **Attention à l'effet de composition.** Si des travailleurs peu rémunérés sont licenciés, le salaire moyen peut augmenter alors que personne n'a reçu de hausse. L'inverse peut se produire lorsque de nombreux travailleurs peu rémunérés sont embauchés.

segments.src: - **Consider other sources.** The BLS Employment Cost Index and the Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker follow compensation in ways that are less sensitive to changes in who is employed.
segments.tr: - **Considérez d'autres sources.** L'indice du coût de l'emploi du BLS et le Wage Growth Tracker de la Fed d'Atlanta suivent la rémunération d'une façon moins sensible aux changements dans l'identité des personnes employées.

segments.src: Wages that grow much faster than productivity can add to inflation pressure.
segments.tr: Des salaires qui progressent beaucoup plus vite que la productivité peuvent alimenter les pressions inflationnistes.

segments.src: Wages that stall can signal a cooling labor market.
segments.tr: Des salaires qui stagnent peuvent signaler un marché du travail en refroidissement.

segments.src: Policymakers watch for both.
segments.tr: Les décideurs surveillent les deux.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Details Worth a Glance
segments.tr: ## 5. Autres détails à regarder

segments.src: - **Average weekly hours.** Employers often trim hours before they cut jobs, so a drop in hours can be an early warning.
segments.tr: - **Durée hebdomadaire moyenne du travail.** Les employeurs réduisent souvent les heures avant de supprimer des postes, donc une baisse des heures peut être un signal précoce.

segments.src: - **Diffusion index.** This shows the share of industries adding jobs. A higher share suggests broader strength.
segments.tr: - **Indice de diffusion.** Il indique la part des secteurs qui créent des emplois. Une part plus élevée suggère une dynamique plus largement répartie.

segments.src: - **Job openings, quits and layoffs.** The separate JOLTS report and weekly jobless claims offer timely cross-checks on hiring and firing.
segments.tr: - **Offres d'emploi, démissions et licenciements.** Le rapport JOLTS distinct et les demandes hebdomadaires d'allocations chômage offrent des recoupements rapides sur les embauches et les licenciements.

segments.src: - **Temporary help and goods-producing employment.** These sectors are sometimes seen as early indicators of changes in business activity.
segments.tr: - **Emplois intérimaires et emplois dans la production de biens.** Ces secteurs sont parfois considérés comme des indicateurs avancés des changements d'activité des entreprises.

segments.src: ## Why the Federal Reserve Cares
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la Réserve fédérale s'y intéresse

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: La Réserve fédérale a un double mandat : le plein emploi et la stabilité des prix.

segments.src: The jobs report speaks to both.
segments.tr: Le rapport sur l'emploi concerne les deux.

segments.src: Strong hiring and fast wage growth may argue for patience on interest rate cuts, or for firmer policy, if inflation is a concern.
segments.tr: Des embauches soutenues et une croissance rapide des salaires peuvent plaider pour la prudence sur les baisses de taux, ou pour une politique plus ferme si l'inflation est préoccupante.

segments.src: A rising unemployment rate, downward revisions and slowing wage growth may strengthen the case for easing.
segments.tr: Un taux de chômage en hausse, des révisions à la baisse et un ralentissement de la croissance des salaires peuvent renforcer l'argument en faveur d'un assouplissement.

segments.src: Markets often react sharply to the headline, but policymakers say they look at a wide range of data over time.
segments.tr: Les marchés réagissent souvent vivement au chiffre phare, mais les décideurs disent examiner un large éventail de données sur la durée.

segments.src: No single report decides the path of interest rates, and the Fed's judgment also draws on inflation readings, financial conditions and its own forecasts.
segments.tr: Aucun rapport isolé ne détermine la trajectoire des taux d'intérêt, et le jugement de la Fed s'appuie aussi sur les indicateurs d'inflation, les conditions financières et ses propres prévisions.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist for Reading the Report
segments.tr: ## Une liste de contrôle simple pour lire le rapport

segments.src: 1. **Headline payrolls:** How does the figure compare with the recent three-month average and with the breakeven pace?
segments.tr: 1. **Effectifs phares :** comment le chiffre se compare-t-il à la moyenne des trois derniers mois et au rythme d'équilibre ?

segments.src: 2. **Revisions:** Were the prior two months revised up or down, and by how much?
segments.tr: 2. **Révisions :** les deux mois précédents ont-ils été révisés à la hausse ou à la baisse, et de combien ?

segments.src: 3. **Unemployment rate:** Did it move because of layoffs, or because people entered or left the labor force?
segments.tr: 3. **Taux de chômage :** a-t-il bougé à cause de licenciements, ou parce que des personnes sont entrées ou sorties de la population active ?

segments.src: 4. **Participation and prime-age employment:** Are more people in their working years employed?
segments.tr: 4. **Participation et emploi des actifs en âge de pleine activité :** davantage de personnes en âge de travailler sont-elles employées ?

segments.src: 5. **Wages:** Is pay growth outpacing inflation, and could composition be distorting it?
segments.tr: 5. **Salaires :** la croissance des salaires dépasse-t-elle l'inflation, et la composition pourrait-elle la fausser ?

segments.src: 6. **Breadth:** Are gains spread across industries or concentrated in a few?
segments.tr: 6. **Largeur :** les gains sont-ils répartis entre les secteurs ou concentrés dans quelques-uns ?

segments.src: 7. **Hours and other signals:** Do they support or contradict the headline?
segments.tr: 7. **Heures et autres signaux :** confirment-ils ou contredisent-ils le chiffre phare ?

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En bref

segments.src: The monthly jobs report is rich, imperfect and frequently revised.
segments.tr: Le rapport mensuel sur l'emploi est riche, imparfait et fréquemment révisé.

segments.src: Treat the first headline as a snapshot, not a verdict.
segments.tr: Considérez le premier chiffre phare comme un instantané, et non comme un verdict.

segments.src: The most reliable insight comes from combining payroll trends, revisions, the unemployment rate and wage growth, then watching whether the pattern holds over several months.
segments.tr: L'information la plus fiable provient de la combinaison des tendances des effectifs, des révisions, du taux de chômage et de la croissance des salaires, puis de l'observation de la persistance de cette tendance sur plusieurs mois.

segments.src: Looked at this way, the report becomes less a source of dramatic surprises and more a steady guide to how the labor market is evolving.
segments.tr: Vu ainsi, le rapport devient moins une source de surprises spectaculaires qu'un guide régulier de l'évolution du marché du travail.

segments.tr: Todo mês, o BLS atualiza suas estimativas para os dois meses anteriores à medida que chegam mais respostas da pesquisa.

segments.src: Once a year, it also performs a larger "benchmark" revision that aligns the survey-based estimates with more complete tax-based employment records.
segments.tr: Uma vez por ano, ele também faz uma revisão mais ampla de "benchmark", que alinha as estimativas baseadas em pesquisa com registros fiscais de emprego mais completos.

segments.src: Why this matters:
segments.tr: Por que isso importa:

segments.src: - **A strong headline can be offset by downward revisions**, leaving the underlying trend weaker than the first impression suggested. The reverse can also happen.
segments.tr: - **Uma manchete forte pode ser compensada por revisões para baixo**, deixando a tendência subjacente mais fraca do que a primeira impressão sugeria. O inverso também pode ocorrer.

segments.src: - **Revisions often show turning points late.** When the economy is changing direction, early estimates can miss the shift, and later revisions fill in the picture.
segments.tr: - **As revisões costumam indicar pontos de inflexão com atraso.** Quando a economia muda de direção, as estimativas iniciais podem não captar a mudança, e as revisões posteriores completam o quadro.

segments.src: - **The first print is a first draft.** Treat it as a preliminary reading rather than a final verdict.
segments.tr: - **O primeiro dado é um rascunho.** Trate-o como uma leitura preliminar, e não como veredito final.

segments.src: A practical habit: when you read about a new report, check the net revision to the prior two months before deciding whether the data looks stronger or weaker than before.
segments.tr: Um hábito prático: ao ler sobre um novo relatório, verifique a revisão líquida dos dois meses anteriores antes de decidir se os dados parecem mais fortes ou mais fracos do que antes.

segments.src: ## 3. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ## 3. A Taxa de Desemprego

segments.src: The unemployment rate is the share of people in the labor force who are without a job and actively looking for work.
segments.tr: A taxa de desemprego é a parcela das pessoas na força de trabalho que está sem emprego e procurando ativamente trabalho.

segments.src: It is a useful summary, but it has quirks.
segments.tr: É um resumo útil, mas tem peculiaridades.

segments.src: - **Small moves can be noise.** A change of one or two tenths of a percentage point is often within the statistical margin and may reverse the following month.
segments.tr: - **Pequenas variações podem ser ruído.** Uma mudança de um ou dois décimos de ponto percentual muitas vezes está dentro da margem estatística e pode reverter no mês seguinte.

segments.src: - **Why the rate moved matters.** The rate can rise because people lose jobs, which is a negative sign. It can also rise because more people enter or re-enter the labor force and have not yet found work, which can be a more neutral or even positive sign.
segments.tr: - **Por que a taxa se moveu importa.** A taxa pode subir porque as pessoas perdem empregos, o que é sinal negativo. Pode também subir porque mais pessoas entram ou reentram na força de trabalho e ainda não encontraram trabalho, o que pode ser um sinal neutro ou até positivo.

segments.src: - **It can fall for unhappy reasons.** If discouraged workers stop looking, they drop out of the labor force and the rate can decline without any improvement in hiring.
segments.tr: - **Ela pode cair por motivos ruins.** Se trabalhadores desanimados param de procurar, saem da força de trabalho e a taxa pode cair sem nenhuma melhora nas contratações.

segments.src: To understand which story is playing out, look beside the headline rate at the **labor force participation rate** and the **employment-to-population ratio** for prime-age workers (ages 25 to 54).
segments.tr: Para entender qual história está em curso, observe, ao lado da taxa principal, a **taxa de participação na força de trabalho** e a **razão emprego-população** dos trabalhadores em idade prime (25 a 54 anos).

segments.src: These measures are less affected by population aging and give a clearer view of how many people in their peak working years are actually employed.
segments.tr: Essas medidas são menos afetadas pelo envelhecimento da população e oferecem uma visão mais clara de quantas pessoas em seus anos de maior atividade estão de fato empregadas.

segments.src: The BLS also publishes broader measures, including the **U-6 rate**, which adds people working part-time who want full-time work and those marginally attached to the labor force.
segments.tr: O BLS também publica medidas mais amplas, incluindo a **taxa U-6**, que soma pessoas em tempo parcial que querem trabalho em tempo integral e pessoas com vínculo marginal com a força de trabalho.

segments.src: A widening gap between U-6 and the headline rate can hint at slack that the headline hides.
segments.tr: Um aumento da diferença entre a U-6 e a taxa principal pode indicar ociosidade que a taxa principal esconde.

segments.src: ## 4. Wage Growth
segments.tr: ## 4. Crescimento Salarial

segments.src: Average hourly earnings show how fast pay is rising, and they connect the jobs report to inflation and household budgets.
segments.tr: Os ganhos médios por hora mostram a velocidade de alta dos salários e conectam o relatório de emprego à inflação e ao orçamento das famílias.

segments.src: - **Look at the year-over-year change** for the broad trend and the monthly change for the latest momentum, while remembering that the monthly figure is volatile.
segments.tr: - **Observe a variação anual** para a tendência ampla e a variação mensal para o impulso mais recente, lembrando que o dado mensal é volátil.

segments.src: - **Compare wage growth with inflation.** If pay rises faster than prices, workers' purchasing power improves. If it lags, real incomes shrink.
segments.tr: - **Compare o crescimento salarial com a inflação.** Se os salários sobem mais rápido que os preços, o poder de compra dos trabalhadores melhora. Se ficam atrás, a renda real encolhe.

segments.src: - **Mind the composition effect.** If lower-paid workers are laid off, average wages can rise even though no one received a raise. The reverse can occur when many lower-paid workers are hired.
segments.tr: - **Atenção ao efeito de composição.** Se trabalhadores de menor remuneração são demitidos, o salário médio pode subir mesmo que ninguém tenha recebido aumento. O inverso pode ocorrer quando muitos trabalhadores de menor remuneração são contratados.

segments.src: - **Consider other sources.** The BLS Employment Cost Index and the Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker follow compensation in ways that are less sensitive to changes in who is employed.
segments.tr: - **Considere outras fontes.** O Employment Cost Index do BLS e o Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker acompanham a remuneração de forma menos sensível a mudanças em quem está empregado.

segments.src: Wages that grow much faster than productivity can add to inflation pressure.
segments.tr: Salários que crescem muito mais rápido que a produtividade podem aumentar a pressão inflacionária.

segments.src: Wages that stall can signal a cooling labor market.
segments.tr: Salários estagnados podem sinalizar um mercado de trabalho em desaceleração.

segments.src: Policymakers watch for both.
segments.tr: Os formuladores de política observam ambos.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Details Worth a Glance
segments.tr: ## 5. Outros Detalhes Dignos de Atenção

segments.src: - **Average weekly hours.** Employers often trim hours before they cut jobs, so a drop in hours can be an early warning.
segments.tr: - **Horas médias semanais.** Empregadores costumam reduzir horas antes de cortar vagas, então uma queda nas horas pode ser um alerta precoce.

segments.src: - **Diffusion index.** This shows the share of industries adding jobs. A higher share suggests broader strength.
segments.tr: - **Índice de difusão.** Mostra a parcela de setores que estão criando empregos. Uma parcela maior sugere força mais ampla.

segments.src: - **Job openings, quits and layoffs.** The separate JOLTS report and weekly jobless claims offer timely cross-checks on hiring and firing.
segments.tr: - **Vagas abertas, demissões voluntárias e demissões.** O relatório JOLTS separado e os pedidos semanais de seguro-desemprego oferecem verificações oportunas sobre contratações e demissões.

segments.src: - **Temporary help and goods-producing employment.** These sectors are sometimes seen as early indicators of changes in business activity.
segments.tr: - **Emprego temporário e na produção de bens.** Esses setores às vezes são vistos como indicadores antecedentes de mudanças na atividade econômica.

segments.src: ## Why the Federal Reserve Cares
segments.tr: ## Por Que o Federal Reserve se Importa

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: O Federal Reserve tem um mandato duplo: máximo emprego e estabilidade de preços.

segments.src: The jobs report speaks to both.
segments.tr: O relatório de emprego fala com ambos.

segments.src: Strong hiring and fast wage growth may argue for patience on interest rate cuts, or for firmer policy, if inflation is a concern.
segments.tr: Contratações fortes e crescimento rápido dos salários podem sugerir cautela em cortes de juros, ou uma política mais firme, se a inflação for uma preocupação.

segments.src: A rising unemployment rate, downward revisions and slowing wage growth may strengthen the case for easing.
segments.tr: Uma alta da taxa de desemprego, revisões para baixo e desaceleração salarial podem fortalecer o argumento para afrouxamento.

segments.src: Markets often react sharply to the headline, but policymakers say they look at a wide range of data over time.
segments.tr: Os mercados frequentemente reagem de forma intensa à manchete, mas os formuladores de política dizem que observam uma ampla gama de dados ao longo do tempo.

segments.src: No single report decides the path of interest rates, and the Fed's judgment also draws on inflation readings, financial conditions and its own forecasts.
segments.tr: Nenhum relatório isolado define o rumo das taxas de juros, e o julgamento do Fed também se apoia em indicadores de inflação, condições financeiras e em suas próprias projeções.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist for Reading the Report
segments.tr: ## Uma Lista de Verificação Simples para Ler o Relatório

segments.src: 1. **Headline payrolls:** How does the figure compare with the recent three-month average and with the breakeven pace?
segments.tr: 1. **Folha de pagamento (manchete):** Como o número se compara com a média dos últimos três meses e com o ritmo de equilíbrio?

segments.src: 2. **Revisions:** Were the prior two months revised up or down, and by how much?
segments.tr: 2. **Revisões:** Os dois meses anteriores foram revisados para cima ou para baixo, e em quanto?

segments.src: 3. **Unemployment rate:** Did it move because of layoffs, or because people entered or left the labor force?
segments.tr: 3. **Taxa de desemprego:** Ela se moveu por causa de demissões ou porque pessoas entraram ou saíram da força de trabalho?

segments.src: 4. **Participation and prime-age employment:** Are more people in their working years employed?
segments.tr: 4. **Participação e emprego em idade prime:** Mais pessoas em idade produtiva estão empregadas?

segments.src: 5. **Wages:** Is pay growth outpacing inflation, and could composition be distorting it?
segments.tr: 5. **Salários:** O crescimento da remuneração supera a inflação, e a composição pode estar distorcendo o dado?

segments.src: 6. **Breadth:** Are gains spread across industries or concentrated in a few?
segments.tr: 6. **Abrangência:** Os ganhos se distribuem entre setores ou se concentram em poucos?

segments.src: 7. **Hours and other signals:** Do they support or contradict the headline?
segments.tr: 7. **Horas e outros sinais:** Eles sustentam ou contradizem a manchete?

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## A Conclusão

segments.src: The monthly jobs report is rich, imperfect and frequently revised.
segments.tr: O relatório mensal de emprego é rico, imperfeito e frequentemente revisado.

segments.src: Treat the first headline as a snapshot, not a verdict.
segments.tr: Trate a primeira manchete como um retrato do momento, e não como veredito.

segments.src: The most reliable insight comes from combining payroll trends, revisions, the unemployment rate and wage growth, then watching whether the pattern holds over several months.
segments.tr: O insight mais confiável vem da combinação de tendências da folha de pagamento, revisões, taxa de desemprego e crescimento salarial, seguida de observação para ver se o padrão se mantém ao longo de vários meses.

segments.src: Looked at this way, the report becomes less a source of dramatic surprises and more a steady guide to how the labor market is evolving.
segments.tr: Visto dessa forma, o relatório deixa de ser uma fonte de surpresas dramáticas e passa a ser um guia constante de como o mercado de trabalho está evoluindo.

in.title: Cara Membaca Laporan Ketenagakerjaan Bulanan: Penggajian, Pengangguran, dan Revisi Dijelaskan

segments.src: Every month, one number tends to dominate the financial headlines: the change in nonfarm payrolls.
segments.tr: Setiap bulan, satu angka biasanya mendominasi judul berita keuangan: perubahan jumlah tenaga kerja nonpertanian (nonfarm payrolls).

segments.src: It is easy to treat it as a simple scorecard for the economy.
segments.tr: Mudah untuk menganggapnya sebagai kartu skor sederhana bagi perekonomian.

segments.src: In practice, the headline is only the starting point.
segments.tr: Dalam praktiknya, angka utama hanyalah titik awal.

segments.src: A careful reader looks at several pieces of the report together, because each answers a different question about the labor market.
segments.tr: Pembaca yang cermat melihat beberapa bagian laporan secara bersamaan, karena setiap bagian menjawab pertanyaan yang berbeda tentang pasar tenaga kerja.

segments.src: This guide walks through what the monthly employment report measures, where its limits are, and how to put the pieces together.
segments.tr: Panduan ini membahas apa yang diukur oleh laporan ketenagakerjaan bulanan, di mana batasannya, dan cara menggabungkan berbagai bagian data.

segments.src: It is general education, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah materi edukasi umum, bukan nasihat investasi atau keuangan.

segments.src: ## Where the Numbers Come From
segments.tr: ## Dari Mana Angka-Angka Ini Berasal

segments.src: The monthly report published by the U.S.
segments.tr: Laporan bulanan yang diterbitkan oleh

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) actually combines two separate surveys:
segments.tr: Biro Statistik Tenaga Kerja Amerika Serikat (BLS) sebenarnya menggabungkan dua survei terpisah:

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** (sometimes called the payroll survey) asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. It produces the headline job gain or loss, as well as average hourly earnings and hours worked.
segments.tr: - **Survei establishment** (kadang disebut survei penggajian) menanyakan kepada pemberi kerja berapa banyak orang yang tercatat dalam daftar gaji mereka. Survei ini menghasilkan angka utama penambahan atau pengurangan lapangan kerja, serta rata-rata upah per jam dan jam kerja.

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. It produces the unemployment rate, the labor force participation rate and the employment-to-population ratio.
segments.tr: - **Survei rumah tangga** menanyakan kepada sampel rumah tangga tentang status pekerjaan mereka. Survei ini menghasilkan tingkat pengangguran, tingkat partisipasi angkatan kerja, dan rasio pekerja terhadap populasi.

segments.src: Because the two surveys use different methods and samples, they can send different signals in the same month.
segments.tr: Karena kedua survei menggunakan metode dan sampel yang berbeda, keduanya bisa memberi sinyal yang berbeda dalam bulan yang sama.

segments.src: That is not necessarily a mistake.
segments.tr: Itu tidak selalu berarti ada kesalahan.

segments.src: It is a reminder that every figure is an estimate with a margin of error.
segments.tr: Itu adalah pengingat bahwa setiap angka adalah estimasi dengan margin kesalahan.

segments.src: ## 1. The Headline Payroll Number
segments.tr: ## 1. Angka Utama Penggajian

segments.src: The payroll figure tells you how many jobs were added or lost across the economy, excluding farm work, private household work and a few other categories.
segments.tr: Angka penggajian menunjukkan berapa banyak lapangan kerja yang ditambahkan atau hilang di seluruh perekonomian, tidak termasuk pekerjaan pertanian, pekerjaan rumah tangga swasta, dan beberapa kategori lainnya.

segments.src: Some points of context help:
segments.tr: Beberapa poin konteks berikut membantu:

segments.src: - **Single months are noisy.** The estimate carries a sampling error of roughly plus or minus 100,000 jobs or so at the 90 percent confidence level. A gain of 150,000 and a gain of 200,000 may not be meaningfully different.
segments.tr: - **Angka bulanan itu sangat fluktuatif.** Estimasi memiliki kesalahan sampling sekitar plus atau minus 100.000 pekerjaan pada tingkat kepercayaan 90 persen. Kenaikan 150.000 dan kenaikan 200.000 mungkin tidak berbeda secara bermakna.

segments.src: - **The trend matters more than any one month.** Many analysts look at a three-month or six-month average to smooth out volatility.
segments.tr: - **Tren lebih penting daripada angka satu bulan.** Banyak analis melihat rata-rata tiga bulan atau enam bulan untuk meredam volatilitas.

segments.src: - **The "right" number depends on the era.** The pace of job growth needed to keep the unemployment rate steady, sometimes called the breakeven rate, depends on labor force growth. When immigration, population aging or participation shifts, the breakeven pace shifts too. A figure that looked weak a few years ago may be adequate today, and vice versa.
segments.tr: - **Angka yang "tepat" bergantung pada era.** Laju pertumbuhan lapangan kerja yang diperlukan untuk menjaga tingkat pengangguran tetap stabil, yang kadang disebut tingkat impas (breakeven rate), bergantung pada pertumbuhan angkatan kerja. Ketika imigrasi, penuaan populasi, atau perubahan partisipasi terjadi, laju impas ikut bergeser. Angka yang tampak lemah beberapa tahun lalu mungkin memadai hari ini, dan sebaliknya.

segments.src: - **Composition counts.** Broad-based gains across many industries are generally a healthier sign than growth concentrated in one or two sectors, such as health care and government.
segments.tr: - **Komposisi itu penting.** Kenaikan yang merata di banyak industri umumnya merupakan tanda yang lebih sehat dibandingkan pertumbuhan yang terkonsentrasi di satu atau dua sektor, seperti layanan kesehatan dan pemerintahan.

segments.src: ## 2. Revisions to Earlier Months
segments.tr: ## 2. Revisi Angka Bulan Sebelumnya

segments.src: Revisions are among the most overlooked parts of the report, and they can be among the most important.
segments.tr: Revisi termasuk bagian laporan yang paling sering terlewat, namun bisa jadi yang paling penting.

segments.src: Each month, the BLS updates its estimates for the two prior months as more survey responses arrive.
segments.tr: Setiap bulan, BLS memperbarui estimasi untuk dua bulan sebelumnya seiring masuknya lebih banyak respons survei.

segments.src: Once a year, it also performs a larger "benchmark" revision that aligns the survey-based estimates with more complete tax-based employment records.
segments.tr: Setahun sekali, BLS juga melakukan revisi "benchmark" yang lebih besar untuk menyelaraskan estimasi berbasis survei dengan catatan ketenagakerjaan pajak yang lebih lengkap.

segments.src: Why this matters:
segments.tr: Mengapa ini penting:

segments.src: - **A strong headline can be offset by downward revisions**, leaving the underlying trend weaker than the first impression suggested. The reverse can also happen.
segments.tr: - **Angka utama yang kuat bisa diimbangi oleh revisi ke bawah**, sehingga tren yang mendasarinya lebih lemah daripada kesan pertama. Hal sebaliknya juga bisa terjadi.

segments.src: - **Revisions often show turning points late.** When the economy is changing direction, early estimates can miss the shift, and later revisions fill in the picture.
segments.tr: - **Revisi sering menunjukkan titik balik secara terlambat.** Ketika perekonomian berbalik arah, estimasi awal bisa melewatkan perubahan itu, dan revisi berikutnya melengkapi gambarannya.

segments.src: - **The first print is a first draft.** Treat it as a preliminary reading rather than a final verdict.
segments.tr: - **Angka rilis pertama adalah draf awal.** Perlakukan sebagai bacaan sementara, bukan vonis final.

segments.src: A practical habit: when you read about a new report, check the net revision to the prior two months before deciding whether the data looks stronger or weaker than before.
segments.tr: Kebiasaan praktis: ketika membaca laporan baru, periksa total revisi untuk dua bulan sebelumnya sebelum memutuskan apakah data tampak lebih kuat atau lebih lemah dibanding sebelumnya.

segments.src: ## 3. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ## 3. Tingkat Pengangguran

segments.src: The unemployment rate is the share of people in the labor force who are without a job and actively looking for work.
segments.tr: Tingkat pengangguran adalah porsi orang dalam angkatan kerja yang tidak memiliki pekerjaan dan aktif mencari kerja.

segments.src: It is a useful summary, but it has quirks.
segments.tr: Ini ringkasan yang berguna, tetapi punya beberapa keunikan.

segments.src: - **Small moves can be noise.** A change of one or two tenths of a percentage point is often within the statistical margin and may reverse the following month.
segments.tr: - **Pergerakan kecil bisa jadi derau.** Perubahan satu atau dua persepuluh poin persentase sering berada dalam margin statistik dan bisa berbalik di bulan berikutnya.

segments.src: - **Why the rate moved matters.** The rate can rise because people lose jobs, which is a negative sign. It can also rise because more people enter or re-enter the labor force and have not yet found work, which can be a more neutral or even positive sign.
segments.tr: - **Alasan perubahan tingkat itu penting.** Tingkat bisa naik karena orang kehilangan pekerjaan, yang merupakan sinyal negatif. Bisa juga naik karena lebih banyak orang masuk atau kembali ke angkatan kerja dan belum mendapat pekerjaan, yang bisa menjadi sinyal netral atau bahkan positif.

segments.src: - **It can fall for unhappy reasons.** If discouraged workers stop looking, they drop out of the labor force and the rate can decline without any improvement in hiring.
segments.tr: - **Tingkat bisa turun karena alasan yang tidak menggembirakan.** Jika pekerja yang putus asa berhenti mencari kerja, mereka keluar dari angkatan kerja dan tingkat pengangguran bisa turun tanpa adanya perbaikan dalam perekrutan.

segments.src: To understand which story is playing out, look beside the headline rate at the **labor force participation rate** and the **employment-to-population ratio** for prime-age workers (ages 25 to 54).
segments.tr: Untuk memahami cerita mana yang sedang terjadi, lihat di samping tingkat utama **tingkat partisipasi angkatan kerja** dan **rasio pekerja terhadap populasi** untuk pekerja usia produktif (25 hingga 54 tahun).

segments.src: These measures are less affected by population aging and give a clearer view of how many people in their peak working years are actually employed.
segments.tr: Ukuran-ukuran ini kurang terpengaruh oleh penuaan populasi dan memberikan gambaran yang lebih jelas tentang berapa banyak orang di usia puncak kerja yang benar-benar bekerja.

segments.src: The BLS also publishes broader measures, including the **U-6 rate**, which adds people working part-time who want full-time work and those marginally attached to the labor force.
segments.tr: BLS juga menerbitkan ukuran yang lebih luas, termasuk **tingkat U-6**, yang menambahkan orang yang bekerja paruh waktu tetapi ingin bekerja penuh waktu, serta orang yang secara marginal terikat pada angkatan kerja.

segments.src: A widening gap between U-6 and the headline rate can hint at slack that the headline hides.
segments.tr: Celah U-6 yang melebar dibandingkan tingkat utama dapat mengisyaratkan adanya kelebihan tenaga kerja (slack) yang tersembunyi di balik angka utama.

segments.src: ## 4. Wage Growth
segments.tr: ## 4. Pertumbuhan Upah

segments.src: Average hourly earnings show how fast pay is rising, and they connect the jobs report to inflation and household budgets.
segments.tr: Rata-rata upah per jam menunjukkan seberapa cepat gaji naik, dan ini menghubungkan laporan ketenagakerjaan dengan inflasi dan anggaran rumah tangga.

segments.src: - **Look at the year-over-year change** for the broad trend and the monthly change for the latest momentum, while remembering that the monthly figure is volatile.
segments.tr: - **Lihat perubahan year-over-year** untuk tren umum dan perubahan bulanan untuk momentum terbaru, dengan tetap mengingat bahwa angka bulanan sangat fluktuatif.

segments.src: - **Compare wage growth with inflation.** If pay rises faster than prices, workers' purchasing power improves. If it lags, real incomes shrink.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan pertumbuhan upah dengan inflasi.** Jika gaji naik lebih cepat dari harga, daya beli pekerja membaik. Jika tertinggal, pendapatan riil menyusut.

segments.src: - **Mind the composition effect.** If lower-paid workers are laid off, average wages can rise even though no one received a raise. The reverse can occur when many lower-paid workers are hired.
segments.tr: - **Perhatikan efek komposisi.** Jika pekerja berupah rendah di-PHK, rata-rata upah bisa naik meskipun tidak ada yang mendapat kenaikan gaji. Hal sebaliknya bisa terjadi ketika banyak pekerja berupah rendah direkrut.

segments.src: - **Consider other sources.** The BLS Employment Cost Index and the Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker follow compensation in ways that are less sensitive to changes in who is employed.
segments.tr: - **Pertimbangkan sumber lain.** Employment Cost Index dari BLS dan Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker mengikuti kompensasi dengan cara yang kurang sensitif terhadap perubahan siapa yang bekerja.

segments.src: Wages that grow much faster than productivity can add to inflation pressure.
segments.tr: Upah yang naik jauh lebih cepat daripada produktivitas dapat menambah tekanan inflasi.

segments.src: Wages that stall can signal a cooling labor market.
segments.tr: Upah yang mandek dapat menjadi tanda pasar tenaga kerja mendingin.

segments.src: Policymakers watch for both.
segments.tr: Pembuat kebijakan memperhatikan keduanya.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Details Worth a Glance
segments.tr: ## 5. Detail Lain yang Layak Dilirik

segments.src: - **Average weekly hours.** Employers often trim hours before they cut jobs, so a drop in hours can be an early warning.
segments.tr: - **Rata-rata jam kerja per minggu.** Pemberi kerja sering memangkas jam kerja sebelum memberhentikan pekerja, sehingga penurunan jam kerja bisa menjadi peringatan dini.

segments.src: - **Diffusion index.** This shows the share of industries adding jobs. A higher share suggests broader strength.
segments.tr: - **Diffusion index.** Indeks ini menunjukkan porsi industri yang menambah lapangan kerja. Porsi yang lebih tinggi menandakan kekuatan yang lebih merata.

segments.src: - **Job openings, quits and layoffs.** The separate JOLTS report and weekly jobless claims offer timely cross-checks on hiring and firing.
segments.tr: - **Lowongan kerja, pengunduran diri, dan PHK.** Laporan JOLTS yang terpisah dan klaim pengangguran mingguan memberikan pemeriksaan silang yang tepat waktu atas perekrutan dan pemberhentian.

segments.src: - **Temporary help and goods-producing employment.** These sectors are sometimes seen as early indicators of changes in business activity.
segments.tr: - **Pekerja sementara dan ketenagakerjaan sektor barang.** Sektor-sektor ini kadang dianggap sebagai indikator awal perubahan aktivitas bisnis.

segments.src: ## Why the Federal Reserve Cares
segments.tr: ## Mengapa The Federal Reserve Peduli

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: The Federal Reserve memiliki mandat ganda: lapangan kerja maksimum dan stabilitas harga.

segments.src: The jobs report speaks to both.
segments.tr: Laporan ketenagakerjaan berbicara tentang keduanya.

segments.src: Strong hiring and fast wage growth may argue for patience on interest rate cuts, or for firmer policy, if inflation is a concern.
segments.tr: Perekrutan yang kuat dan pertumbuhan upah yang cepat dapat mendukung sikap sabar terhadap pemangkasan suku bunga, atau kebijakan yang lebih ketat jika inflasi menjadi perhatian.

segments.src: A rising unemployment rate, downward revisions and slowing wage growth may strengthen the case for easing.
segments.tr: Kenaikan tingkat pengangguran, revisi ke bawah, dan melambatnya pertumbuhan upah dapat memperkuat alasan untuk pelonggaran.

segments.src: Markets often react sharply to the headline, but policymakers say they look at a wide range of data over time.
segments.tr: Pasar sering bereaksi tajam terhadap angka utama, tetapi para pembuat kebijakan mengatakan mereka melihat berbagai data dalam jangka waktu yang panjang.

segments.src: No single report decides the path of interest rates, and the Fed's judgment also draws on inflation readings, financial conditions and its own forecasts.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu laporan pun yang menentukan arah suku bunga, dan penilaian The Fed juga bersandar pada data inflasi, kondisi keuangan, serta proyeksinya sendiri.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist for Reading the Report
segments.tr: ## Daftar Periksa Sederhana untuk Membaca Laporan

segments.src: 1. **Headline payrolls:** How does the figure compare with the recent three-month average and with the breakeven pace?
segments.tr: 1. **Angka utama penggajian:** Bagaimana angka ini dibandingkan dengan rata-rata tiga bulan terakhir dan dengan laju impas?

segments.src: 2. **Revisions:** Were the prior two months revised up or down, and by how much?
segments.tr: 2. **Revisi:** Apakah dua bulan sebelumnya direvisi naik atau turun, dan seberapa besar?

segments.src: 3. **Unemployment rate:** Did it move because of layoffs, or because people entered or left the labor force?
segments.tr: 3. **Tingkat pengangguran:** Apakah berubah karena PHK, atau karena orang masuk atau keluar dari angkatan kerja?

segments.src: 4. **Participation and prime-age employment:** Are more people in their working years employed?
segments.tr: 4. **Partisipasi dan pekerjaan usia produktif:** Apakah lebih banyak orang di usia kerja yang bekerja?

segments.src: 5. **Wages:** Is pay growth outpacing inflation, and could composition be distorting it?
segments.tr: 5. **Upah:** Apakah pertumbuhan gaji melampaui inflasi, dan apakah komposisi bisa mendistorsinya?

segments.src: 6. **Breadth:** Are gains spread across industries or concentrated in a few?
segments.tr: 6. **Sebaran:** Apakah kenaikan tersebar di berbagai industri atau terkonsentrasi di beberapa saja?

segments.src: 7. **Hours and other signals:** Do they support or contradict the headline?
segments.tr: 7. **Jam kerja dan sinyal lain:** Apakah mendukung atau bertentangan dengan angka utama?

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The monthly jobs report is rich, imperfect and frequently revised.
segments.tr: Laporan ketenagakerjaan bulanan kaya informasi, tidak sempurna, dan sering direvisi.

segments.src: Treat the first headline as a snapshot, not a verdict.
segments.tr: Perlakukan angka utama pertama sebagai potret sesaat, bukan vonis.

segments.src: The most reliable insight comes from combining payroll trends, revisions, the unemployment rate and wage growth, then watching whether the pattern holds over several months.
segments.tr: Wawasan paling andal berasal dari menggabungkan tren penggajian, revisi, tingkat pengangguran, dan pertumbuhan upah, lalu memantau apakah pola itu bertahan selama beberapa bulan.

segments.src: Looked at this way, the report becomes less a source of dramatic surprises and more a steady guide to how the labor market is evolving.
segments.tr: Dilihat dengan cara ini, laporan tersebut menjadi bukan sumber kejutan dramatis, melainkan panduan yang stabil tentang bagaimana pasar tenaga kerja berkembang.
